issues.problem: There is a single printed cit (śiriṇāyāṃ cid aktunā).

issues.problem: "स्त्रियों" (women) is an addition; purupeśāsu is only "in the many-formed (fem.) ones", as the English says.
English "all beings" vs Hindi भुवन (worlds); bhuvana should be rendered the same in both. No patch.
"वस्तु" and "चुनी हुई" are added; English has "with choice" (vareṇa).

summary: Reviewed 6 units. Errors: unit 3 Hindi adds 'स्त्रियों'; unit 3 split lists cit twice and in the wrong order. Minor: Hindi/English mismatches (महिमा vs powers, चुनी हुई वस्तु), envoy vs messenger, notes saying cit is taken twice, unit 1 text flag on the digit notation is not a typo. Units 4-5 are low-confidence but honest. No regrouping suggested.
